error_analysis.summary: The model annotation contains several errors, including misinterpretation of the x-axis tick interval, omission of specific x-axis tick values, and a hallucination regarding the x-axis scale type.

hallucination.model_said: x轴标签是“模型词汇量”，具有线性刻度
hallucination.human_said: x轴为‘模型词汇量’，范围从 mBERT-0 到 mBERT-100，刻度间隔不均匀
hallucination.severity_explanation: The model incorrectly states that the x-axis has a linear scale, while the gold annotation specifies that the tick intervals are uneven. This significantly affects the interpretation of the figure.

omission.human_said: 范围从 mBERT-0 到 mBERT-100，刻度间隔不均匀（如 mBERT-0、10、30、50、80、100)
omission.severity_explanation: The model omits the specific uneven tick values provided in the gold annotation, which are important for understanding the x-axis scale.

misinterpretation.severity_explanation: The model incorrectly describes the x-axis tick interval as uniform (mBERT-10), whereas the gold annotation specifies uneven intervals. This misinterpretation significantly alters the understanding of the data distribution.
